ADVANTAGES.TITLE: Why choose us?
ADVANTAGES.DESCRIPTION: Everything to help you confidently pass an interview, from practice with real cases to mentor support.
ADVANTAGES.CARD_1_TEXT: We are not limited to one specialty. Learnizy has courses in development, marketing, logistics, business analysis and other in-demand fields
ADVANTAGES.CARD_2_TEXT: Under the income share agreement, tuition comes out of your salary, and only once there is a salary to come out of
ADVANTAGES.CARD_3_TEXT: Your work is reviewed by practitioners who sit on the other side of the interview table every week and know what gets a candidate rejected
ADVANTAGES.CARD_4_TEXT: The AI simulator lets you fail a question privately, as many times as it takes, and tells you exactly what was missing from the answer

HERO.TITLE: First the offer. Then the invoice.
HERO.DESCRIPTION: Learnizy prepares specialists alongside mentors from top companies. Rehearse on the AI simulator until the answers come easily. 87% of graduates get an offer.
HERO.NOTE: No card required. Tuition comes out of your salary once there is one.
HERO.PANEL_QUESTION: Tell me about a task you got wrong. What did you do next?
HERO.PANEL_ANSWER: I misjudged the timeline and realised it halfway through. I flagged it to the team the same day, rebuilt the plan and shipped a reduced scope on time.
HERO.PANEL_REVIEW: Solid answer. Add what you changed in how you estimate afterwards and it becomes a strong one.

HOW_IT_WORKS.TITLE: How it works
HOW_IT_WORKS.DESCRIPTION: Four steps from the first module to a signed offer. You pay at the fourth.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_1_TEXT: Choose a specialty from the catalogue. An entry test sets your starting level so you skip what you already know.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_2_TEXT: Modules, work on real tasks, and reviews of everything you produce from people who do the job daily.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_3_TEXT: The AI simulator asks what real interviewers ask, then shows exactly where the answer fell short.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP_4_TEXT: 87% of graduates sign within six months. Tuition starts coming out of your salary, not a day before.

AI.TITLE: Rehearse until the nerves are gone
AI.TEXT: Ask it to drill your weakest topic at two in the morning. It never tires, never softens the follow-up question, and remembers what you keep avoiding.

EXPLORE.TITLE: What is inside
EXPLORE.DESCRIPTION: Every part of the platform, one click away.
EXPLORE.COURSES_TEXT: Full tracks with a mentor, from the first steps to a portfolio project.
EXPLORE.MODULES_TEXT: Short focused blocks: one topic, one test, one review.
EXPLORE.EXAMS_TEXT: Timed checkpoints built like the real thing.
EXPLORE.AI_ASSISTANT_TEXT: Practice interviews on demand, with a written review of every answer.
EXPLORE.KNOWLEDGE_BASE_TEXT: The questions interviewers actually ask, and answers worth memorising.
EXPLORE.PROJECTS_TEXT: Real cases you can put in front of a hiring manager.

CTA.TITLE: Your next interview can go differently
CTA.TEXT: Create an account and take the entry test. It takes twenty minutes and costs nothing.
